_note: 推荐使用。v5 配乐（敬畏 + 不安）。模型 elevenlabs/music/v2.5，seed 1231。audio_reference 填一首对味参考曲的 60 秒片段的签名链接（这次用 Scott Buckley《Decoherence》第 40–100 秒）。各段时长对应 STYLE.md 的分镜。

chunks.text:
[Cold Open]
{instrumental, cold and vast, a low sub drone, slowly morphing dark synth textures, a few distant sparse piano notes, late night unease, lots of empty space}

[Something Wakes]
{instrumental, dissonant strings slowly creeping upward, unsettling low pulses, a cold synth tone that will not resolve, tension rising, something inhuman awakens}

[Decision]
{instrumental, sudden near silence, one eerie sustained high string harmonic over a faint deep sub swell}

[Machine Thinking]
{instrumental, a relentless mechanical ostinato in a minor key, cold staccato low strings and ticking synth pulses, inhuman precision, ominous, slowly intensifying, never heroic}

[Event Horizon]
{instrumental, the pulse falls away, a dark swelling crescendo, choir-like synth pad and low brass rising together, overwhelming awe mixed with dread}

[Singularity]
{instrumental, one enormous low drone hit, then almost a vacuum, only a vast dark reverb tail hanging in space}

[Afterwards]
{instrumental, quiet and fragile, a solitary piano with distant strings, suspended unresolved harmony, melancholic awe, slowly fading into silence}
